{"id":2042934537,"question_id":4015,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month","timestamp":1782193256,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"20 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2042934537/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Split Array With Minimum Difference","memory":"171 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n\n    long long splitArray(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<bool>incseq(n , false);\n        vector<bool>decseq(n , false);\n\n        incseq[0] = true;\n        decseq[n-1] = true;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++) incseq[i] = incseq[i-1] and (nums[i] > nums[i-1]);\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i>=0 ; i--) decseq[i] = decseq[i+1] and (nums[i] > nums[i+1]);\n\n        ll sum = accumulate(begin(nums) , end(nums) , 0LL);\n\n        ll leftsum = nums[0];\n        ll rightsum = sum - nums[0];\n        ll ans = LLONG_MAX;\n\n        if(incseq[0] == true and decseq[1] == true) ans = min(ans , abs(leftsum - rightsum));\n\n        for(int i = 1; i<n-1 ; i++)\n        {\n            leftsum += nums[i];\n            rightsum -= nums[i];\n\n            ll diff = abs(leftsum - rightsum);\n\n            if(incseq[i] == true and decseq[i+1] == true) ans = min(ans , (diff));\n        }\n        return ans == LLONG_MAX ? -1 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"split-array-with-minimum-difference","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2211}
